name: kestrel
description: Kestrel language support: highlighting, errors as you type, hover, go to definition, and the cost lens.

kestrel.server.path.description: The kestrel-lsp executable. Empty: kestrel-lsp on PATH, else the one built in this repository (target/release, then target/debug).

kestrel.costLens.enabled.description: Show every check, allocation and other way to fail that the compiler leaves in, and why (what `kestrel check --report` says), on each line. Runs when a file is opened or saved.

enumDescriptions: The checks of `kestrel run` (overflow checks included).
kestrel.costLens.build.description: Which build's checks the cost lens shows.

enumDescriptions: A hint at the end of the line.
An Information diagnostic on the line (also listed in Problems).
kestrel.costLens.show.description: How the cost lens shows what it found.
